subject: Data retention exception and next steps — FinVault discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@finvault.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finvault.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: FinVault discovery recap + follow-ups on retention

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the items I promised to follow up on: 

1) Data types: You confirmed that FinVault will be sending transaction metadata and customer support transcripts which may contain PII (names, emails, last 4 digits of card numbers).
2) Retention requirement: Legal asked whether Redwood can support a shortened retention window for logs (30 days) for production telemetry and a separate 0-retention option for actual user payloads containing PII.
3) Logging and audit: You need access to audit logs for admin actions for at least 12 months for compliance.
4) Residency: Production inference must run in us-west region with optional encryption keys in your KMS.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll loop in our security lead (Marissa) to confirm if we can offer a 0-retention option for PII payloads and a 30-day telemetry schedule.
- We’ll provide our security whitepaper and a draft of the DPA with the retention redlines.
- If the retention exception looks doable, we’ll surface impact on SLAs and cost.

I’ve attached our security whitepaper and will send the DPA redlines in a separate email. Can you confirm whether FinVault needs logs retained for any of the payload data beyond audit logs?

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Attachment: security_whitepaper.pdf (11 pages, pdf)
From: Elena Rodriguez <elena@finvault.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finvault.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FinVault discovery recap + follow-ups on retention

Thanks Camila — good summary. A few clarifications from Legal and Security: 

- For payloads that contain PII (customer messages, support transcripts), FinVault’s policy is to not persist full payloads in logs by default. We’re looking for a vendor-side 0-retention option (i.e., no persistent storage after response) or a guaranteed ephemeral store where only hashed identifiers are kept.
- Telemetry (latency, error rates, request IDs) can be retained for 30 days, but we need to ensure those telemetry logs don’t contain any PII.
- Audit logs for admin/API key activities need to be retained for 12 months; this can be stored in encrypted S3 with access controls.

Related: our procurement team needs to see any SLA impact and the DPA with redlines. If Redwood can provide the 0-retention option for payloads, FinVault is ready to move forward on a pilot.

Elena
Elena Rodriguez
Head of Security & Compliance | FinVault
elena@finvault.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Elena Rodriguez <elena@finvault.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FinVault discovery recap + follow-ups on retention

Hi Elena / Camila —

Really appreciate the clear requirements. High level: yes, we can support a 0-retention configuration for request payloads that contain PII by enabling an ephemeral processing mode in the private deployment and by disabling any persistent request/response logging. A few implementation notes and constraints: 

- Ephemeral mode: Payloads are kept in memory on the inference node and not written to disk. We will not store request/response bodies in our long-term logs when this mode is enabled.
- Telemetry: Metrics and traces will be scrubbed of payload fields; we’ll provide a config flag to enforce PII redaction before metrics emit. Telemetry retention window: configurable to 30 days.
- Audit logs: We continue to write admin/audit events for access and config changes and can retain those for 12 months per your requirement. Audit logs will contain user IDs and event metadata but not full payloads.
- Residency & KMS: We can deploy the inference workers in us-west and integrate with your KMS for envelope keys.

Open items we need from FinVault to proceed with a pilot and DPA redlines: 
1) A short list of sample payloads (redacted) so we can validate the scrub/ephemeral flow.
2) Confirm whether FinVault requires any subset of payloads to be searchable (if yes, that precludes 0-retention).
3) Legal: which clauses in the DPA are non-negotiable vs. open to redlines (we’ve prepared DPA_redlines.docx).

I’m attaching the DPA redlines for your legal team to review. Rafael from Solutions is copied to weigh in on deployment and any ops caveats.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: DPA_redlines.docx (Word doc, 6 pages)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@finvault.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@finvault.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FinVault discovery recap + follow-ups on retention

Thanks Marissa — and thanks Elena for the quick reply. Quick next-steps and proposal from our side so we’re aligned on the pilot: 

Proposed pilot scope (2 weeks):
- Deploy ephemeral inference nodes in us-west with PII redact flag turned on.
- Telemetry retention configured to 30 days; we will provide sanitized dashboards for FinVault engineers.
- Audit logs retained for 12 months and exported to your S3 (we’ll send an S3 write role proposal).
- Redwood to sign a DPA with the redlines attached; we’ll mark the retention clause as an exception for the pilot (0-retention for PII payloads) and include rollback steps.

Action items:
- Elena / FinVault: confirm sample payloads (redacted) and which environments to target for the pilot (staging vs. production).
- Elena / Legal: review DPA_redlines.docx and add comments or mark non-negotiables.
- Rafael: can you prepare an ops note outlining the steps for ephemeral node deployment and any expected performance implications? (cc’d)

If FinVault confirms by EOD Friday (20 Feb) we can schedule a short kickoff and have the pilot live within 5 business days.

Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
